question: If the selling price of an article is ₹ 900 and the discount is 40%, then find its marked price (in ₹).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__****SP = Rs. 900 and discount = 40% **SP = (100 - Discount)/100 × MP

⇒ 900 = (100 - 40)/100 × MP

⇒ 900 = 60/100 × MP

⇒ MP =** 1500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:**

Selling Price = Rs.900

Discount = 40%

**Formula used:**

Discount (D) = MP - SP

Discount percent (D%) = (D/MP) × 100

Where SP = selling price

MP = marked price

**Calculation:**

SP = Rs.900

D% = 40%

D% = (MP - SP)/MP × 100

⇒ 40 = (MP - 900)/MP × 100

⇒ 40/100 = 1 - 900/MP

⇒ 900/MP = 1 - 2/5 = 3/5

⇒ MP = 900 × 5/3

⇒ MP = Rs.1500

**∴ The marked price is Rs.1500.**
